newsitem.title: DUBAI: Three Pakistanis beheaded in Saudi Arabia.
newsitem.headline: Three Pakistanis beheaded in Saudi Arabia.

text.p: Saudi Arabia beheaded three Pakistanis on Wednesday, two for smuggling heroin and one for killing a colleague, state-run Saudi television said.
It quoted the interior ministry as saying drug smugglers Mohammad Aleem Khan and Mohammad Amin Mahjoub Basha were executed in the Red Sea port city of Jeddah. It gave no further details
The third Pakistani, who killed a colleague with an axe, was beheaded in the holy Moslem city of Medina.

Fifty-two people have been executed in the conservative Moslem kingdom so far this year. Saudi Arabia strictly enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading by the sword convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
